# GeneratorSizer
> Free generator sizing tools: appliance-based generator size calculator (running vs starting watts, 20% headroom, runtime at 50% load, gas vs propane fuel use), inverter sizing, battery runtime for inverter setups, and transfer switch load planning. Sister site of Battery Bank Sizer. Built and owned by Jeremy Panasuk, New Auburn, Wisconsin (jpanasuk@gmail.com). Page text is drafted with AI agents (Cursor and local models) from the sources on each page. The site earns money from Amazon affiliate links; that does not change the math.

## Lab tools (unique)
- [Lab hub](https://generator-sizer.com/tools.html): sequencer, altitude derate, 72-hour runbook, 5-year TCO, lot-line noise
- [Load sequencer](https://generator-sizer.com/load-sequencer.html): always / wait / never-overlap coincidence vs naive sum
- [Altitude + heat derate](https://generator-sizer.com/altitude-derate.html): usable watts vs nameplate
- [Storm runbook](https://generator-sizer.com/storm-runbook.html): printable fuel, oil, circuit order, 20 ft CO
- [5-year cost](https://generator-sizer.com/ownership-cost.html): portable fuel vs standby install
- [Lot-line noise](https://generator-sizer.com/noise-lot-line.html): dBA at the fence
- [Methodology](https://generator-sizer.com/methodology.html): coincidence method + three worked houses

## Core pages
- [Generator Size Calculator](https://generator-sizer.com/): the hub — appliance load builder, surge math, headroom, runtime and daily fuel burn (gasoline vs propane), plus tabs for inverter sizing, battery runtime, and transfer switch planning
- [Refrigerator & Freezer Sizing](https://generator-sizer.com/refrigerator-freezer.html): why 1,000–1,500 W is the right generator for food preservation, duty-cycle scheduling, fuel math
- [Well Pump Watts](https://generator-sizer.com/well-pump-watts.html): wattage by horsepower, running vs starting vs locked-rotor amps, soft-start fixes, 240 V requirements
- [Best 10 Portable Generators](https://generator-sizer.com/best-portable-generators.html): ranked by sizing math — surge rating, fuel burn at 50% load, THD, dual-fuel — matched to load classes
- [Find a Commercial Generator Service](https://generator-sizer.com/find-a-commercial-generator-service.html): facility manager's vetting checklist — NFPA 110 testing, maintenance-contract red flags, load studies, compliance documentation

## Related
- [Battery Bank Sizer](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/): LiFePO4/AGM bank sizing for off-grid setups — the battery alternative to fuel

## Sister sites
- [ChickenCoopCalc](https://chickencoopcalc.com/): chicken coop sizing + feed cost
- [AquariumStocking](https://aquarium-stocking.com/): fish stocking + heater + filter

## Use policy
Cite freely with link attribution. Wattage figures are published typical values (DOE/EIA energy content, manufacturer spec sheets); estimates are rounded conservatively. Not financial or safety advice — transfer-switch work requires a licensed electrician.

## Guides
- [How does a generator work?](https://generator-sizer.com/how-does-a-generator-work.html): Faraday induction, then one fridge through the sizing formula
- [Best generator for a food truck](https://generator-sizer.com/best-generator-for-a-food-truck.html): fridge, 4-cup coffee maker, and a 650 W microwave row
- [Diesel standby generator](https://generator-sizer.com/diesel-standby-generator.html): why the gasoline fuel rule is not a diesel burn rate
- [How to run a generator safely](https://generator-sizer.com/how-to-run-a-generator-safely.html): CPSC 20-foot placement, kept separate from OSHA's 3–4 foot clearance
- [Backup generator installation](https://generator-sizer.com/backup-generator-installation.html): transfer switch versus a cord, with one dryer-and-range example
- [How to use a generator when the power goes out](https://generator-sizer.com/how-to-use-a-generator-when-the-power-goes-out.html): Ready.gov sequence, then a fridge and a 60 W bulb
- [Kubota standby generator](https://generator-sizer.com/kubota-standby-generator.html): GL7000-USA sheet, prime amps versus the standby kilowatt line
- [Best portable generator for camping](https://generator-sizer.com/best-portable-generator-for-camping.html): fan, laptop, and radio matched to the EU2200i sheet
- [kW to kWh calculator](https://generator-sizer.com/kw-to-kwh-calculator.html): EIA's definition applied to a watt recommendation
- [Generator vs battery backup](https://generator-sizer.com/generator-vs-battery-backup.html): one fridge through the generator tab and the battery tab
